findings.description: New building permits have been filed for the 100%-affordable, 15-storey, 175-unit New Asia project at 772 Pacific Avenue in Chinatown, above a rebuilt banquet hall replacing the 1919-built one currently home to New Asia Restaurant; construction is expected to start in February 2027. The city bought 772 Pacific Avenue in 2017 and Chinatown Community Development Corporation bought the adjoining 758 Pacific Avenue in 2023, planning to transfer it to the city to merge the lots before the construction loan closes; the state awarded the CCDC/MOHCD partnership $33.5 million in September 2025. Herman Coliver Locus Architecture and Stan Teng Architectural Studio are jointly designing it.
